layouts.name: V1 Auto World 4.3
layouts.description: The venue operator identifies its 4.29 km international course with the permanent northern circuit, full western street return, small inner U return and long southeastern divided-road extension. The operator plan and independently published 2023 full-course event map identify these branches only. Exact pinned public OSM raceway and street nodes supply the mapped parts; licensed September 2026 satellite imagery locates the three missing course connections and the complete western hairpin. The short permanent-course return, intermediate western street U-turn, pit lane and surrounding civilian junction alternatives are excluded. The independent draft measures 4,278.5 m against the supplied 4,287 m scalar. Temporary race barriers, lane selection and historical street changes remain unverified. No points are moved to match either distance. Native satellite ground resolution is 10 m. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. Fine corner alignment and historical direction remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 4278.5 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
